title: The nine default rules are listed and can be switched off (fake data)
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData and open Settings › Importance & labels (Rules tab)
Read the Default rules section, then switch off “Bulk or automated mail is never Respond”
Press ⌘Z in the mail window, then come back to Settings
expected: Nine default rows show a title, one line on what each does and a switch; the importance-guard row says it is not active in this build and its switch is disabled. Switching a row off shows the new version number under the page; ⌘Z switches it back on.
